heroHeadline: Cernavodă Restart Pushed Beyond Mid-September as Romania Pays Record Power-Import Prices
heroSubtitle: Nuclearelectrica says Danube conditions remain too low to restart even one Cernavodă reactor, pushing recovery past the earlier 10 September estimate and keeping Romania paying record power-import prices — August's day-ahead price hit 793 lei/MWh, roughly double a year ago — while EFFIS puts the EU's cumulative 2026 wildfire total at 655,658 hectares as extreme fire danger persists across Iberia, France, the Alps and the Balkans.
footerNote: Data sourced from official reports, major outlets, and institutional analyses.
